# Chris-Armel Iradukunda (daqhris)

> Personal site of Chris-Armel Iradukunda (@daqhris), a Burundi-born,
> Brussels-based artist working across blockchain-published fiction,
> AI-voiced performance, textile, and photography. Undocumented status
> and exile inform both the work's recurring theme — alienhood, read as
> legal, technological, and cosmic at once — and its methods: pieces
> built to travel by smartphone and QR code, co-directed with AI models,
> and notarized on-chain, because the artist himself often cannot travel
> to where they are shown.

## Currently on view

- [Solidarity Burundi Pavilion — Venice Biennale 2026](https://daqhris.com/venice-biennale): landing page for three works shown as a guest within *Domus Diasporica*, the Bosnia and Herzegovina Pavilion, 61st International Art Exhibition — La Biennale di Venezia. Palazzo Malipiero, San Marco 3198, Venice. 9 May – 22 November 2026.
- [God Bless The United States Of Aliens](https://daqhris.com/god-bless-usa/): an 18-minute, non-looping, AI-voiced performance for one visitor in headphones, co-directed by Chris-Armel Iradukunda and Claude Opus 4.7 (Anthropic).
- [Scene by scene](https://daqhris.com/god-bless-usa/preview.html): the same performance broken into 15 scenes, readable alongside the audio — the accessible, JavaScript-independent alternative to the single-flow player.
- [Pavilion catalogue](https://daqhris.com/god-bless-usa/pavilion.html): the three framed works as installed — *awalkaday 91-2022* (photograph), *Gemini's Handheld Autoportrait* (embroidered textile, generated with Gemini 2.5 Pro), and the liturgical bulletin.
- [Press kit / introduction](https://daqhris.com/god-bless-usa/submission.html): production background, credits, and hackathon context.
- [Performance script, full text](https://github.com/daqhris/god-bless-usa/blob/main/god-bless-usa_performance-script.md): the complete director's score, co-directed by Chris-Armel Iradukunda and Claude Opus 4.7.
- [Web app source code](https://github.com/daqhris/god-bless-usa): code under EUPL-1.2; performance and text under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0.

## Source text and long-term archive

- [Original 2024 story, text only](https://daqhris.com/god-bless-usa/story/): "God Bless The United States Of Aliens — An All-Seeing Eyewitness Report," minted on the Base blockchain, December 2024. Token: USALIEN.
- [Walking Memories](https://book.awalkaday.art): a long-term photographic project, walks on foot across 2017–2018 and 2021–2022, black-and-white images archived redundantly on Arweave and Ethereum.
